_why: The frontend's budget-basis tests assert the LIVE default carbon budget (1150 Gt, SSP1-2.6, CO2-eq). Those values are backend data. Asserted as bare literals in a .tsx file they break a frontend test whenever the budget data moves — a break the backend author does not see and cannot interpret. This fixture is generated from build_carbon_budget() and kept in sync by the backend test above, which fails FIRST and says what to regenerate.

default_carbon_budget.budget_source: IPCC AR6 WG1 Table SPM.2 (1350 Gt from 2020, -200 Gt 2020-2024 = 1150 Gt remaining; AR6 50 Gt rounding convention)

co2e_conversion.source: CO2→CO2e GWP100 budget factor f=1.4846 = (m·x20+b−C)/x25; m=1.2935, b=218.41, C=257.4 GtCO2e — all refitted over AR6 C3+C4 (method: Meinshausen et al. 2018/2019 as applied by Tilsted & Bjorn 2023, doi:10.1007/s10584-023-03583-4). x20=1350 GtCO2, x25=1150 GtCO2. See mapper/data/aesa/co2e_ratio/README.md
